review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–49) and the related definitions in the repo: realMat, ofReal, quasiChar and diagOne. I also searched the repo for other Gaussian or polynomial-Gaussian definitions. gaussian3 is the specific function exp(-π·Σ M_ib²) on 2×3 real matrices, and the repo has no competing version of it. polyGauss3 is a set of polynomial-times-Gaussian functions, which looks specific to this development. godementInner3, jacquetIntegrand3 and jacquetVector3 are bespoke integral definitions with no Mathlib counterpart. I did not find a Mathlib definition that represents the same concept under matching assumptions. Mathlib's Gaussian and Fourier material concerns inner product spaces and would only be reached by a conversion, so I saw no concrete cost from duplication. jacquetVector3_eq is only a rfl unfolding lemma, which this rubric excludes. I could not verify some Mathlib Gaussian-on-matrix APIs exhaustively, so a small uncertainty remains.
